card.fires_on: Mostly the word "of" after nouns like presence or shape, and pieces of imaging-agent names or section numbers, in label text about PET/MRI scans and injection sites.

modes.label: "of" after a noun
modes.description: The word "of" right after presence or shape, leading into infection or brain structures.

modes.description: A digit in a Warnings and Precautions cross-reference about MRI.
